SERVICES.DESCRIPTION: Support services in a tree. Agents pick the service in the conversation and customers in the Portal.
SERVICES.SUBTITLE: Set where the service sits in the tree, who sees it and what it fills in the conversation.

FORM.DESCRIPTION_PLACEHOLDER: Explain when to use this service
FORM.VISIBLE_HINT: Customers see this service when opening a ticket in the Portal
FORM.INTERNAL_HINT: Internal service: only agents see it, customers do not see it in the Portal
FORM.ALLOW_FINISH_HINT: The ticket can be resolved with this service
FORM.ALL_CATEGORIES_HINT: Turn off to pick only some request types
FORM.MACRO_LABEL: Macro applied when the service is picked
FORM.MACRO_HINT: When the agent picks this service in the conversation, the macro runs right away

CATEGORIES.DESCRIPTION: Request types (Movidesk categories) and the priorities each one accepts.
CATEGORIES.SUBTITLE: Set the name, the ticket type and the allowed priorities.

FORM.PRIORITIES_HINT: With none checked, every priority is allowed

STATUSES.DESCRIPTION: Support statuses. Each one points to a type, which sets the conversation status in Chatwoot.
STATUSES.SUBTITLE: Set the name, the status type and whether it asks for a justification.

FORM.BASE_HINT: Sets the conversation status in Chatwoot: New and In progress = open, On hold = pending, Resolved/Closed/Cancelled = resolved
FORM.REQUIRES_JUSTIFICATION_HINT: The agent must pick a justification when using this status

JUSTIFICATIONS.DESCRIPTION: Justifications the agent picks when using a status that requires one.
JUSTIFICATIONS.SUBTITLE: Set the name, the ticket type and the statuses where it can be used.

FORM.STATUSES_TITLE: Statuses where it can be used
FORM.STATUSES_HINT: The justification only shows up for the checked statuses

CUSTOM_FIELDS.DESCRIPTION: Extra ticket fields (checklists, classifications). They only show up when a display rule includes them.
CUSTOM_FIELDS.SUBTITLE: Set the name, type and options. Where and when it shows up is set in the display rule.

FORM.KEY_HINT: Generated from the name on creation and never changes. The value syncs with the Portal through it.
FORM.HINT_PLACEHOLDER: Shown next to the field on the ticket
FORM.OPTIONS_HINT: One option per line, in display order

CONVERSATION.EMPTY: No additional fields for this ticket service and request type
CONVERSATION.SAVE_ERROR: Could not save the field, try again
CONVERSATION.MISSING_ON_RESOLVE: Fill in the required additional fields before resolving: {fields}

FIELD_RULES.DESCRIPTION: When each additional field shows up on the ticket: by service, request type, another field value and more.
FIELD_RULES.SUBTITLE: Set the conditions and the fields shown when they match.

all.TITLE: Combined conditions
all.HINT: The rule must match all of these conditions

any.TITLE: Independent conditions
any.HINT: The rule must match at least one of these conditions

REQUIRED_ON.abertura: On opening, for agents and customers

FLAGS.visible_to_clients: Partner sees and fills on opening

FORM.CONDITIONS_HINT: Using both kinds, the ticket must match all combined conditions and at least one independent condition. With no conditions, the rule applies to every ticket.
FORM.FIELDS_HINT: In the order they show on the ticket. Columns: field width in a 12-column row.
